data.gender_notes: Danyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'dunya', meaning 'gift' or 'grace'. In Islamic tradition, it represents the blessings and gifts bestowed upon us by Allah. The name Danyah carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Danyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
